In this week, we will discuss coral reef ecology. What is a coral? What is a coral reef? How do we understand the symbiosis between corals and their zooxanthelle? What ecological interactions are important to maintain the structure and function of a coral reef, and what happens when they are disrupted by human impacts?

## ✍️ Coursework

For all readings, username is biol311 and password is marinebio!!

This week we will read from [Duffy 2021](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/readings/coral_reefs/duffy_coral_reefs.pdf) to get a grounded and thorough understanding of the ecosystem.

We'll also be talking this week about [@soaresExtremeMarginalCoral2026](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/readings/coral_reefs/Soares_etal_2026_ExtremeMarginalReefs.pdf) in lecture. This reading is optional, but REALLY interesting and useful.

For your Wednesday paper discussion, please read [@roosDriversAbundanceBiomass2019](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/readings/coral_reefs/Roos%20et%20al.%20-%202019%20-%20Drivers%20of%20abundance%20and%20biomass%20of%20Brazilian%20parrotfishes.pdf)

## 🧠🐛❓ Would you like to know more?

If you want to bring algae - and particularly coralline algae - back into the picture, check out [@teichertPossibleLinkCoral2020](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/readings/coral_reefs/Teichert%20et%20al.%20-%202020%20-%20A%20possible%20link%20between%20coral%20reef%20success,%20crustose%20coralline%20algae%20and%20the%20evolution%20of%20herbivory.pdf)

For more on nutrient effects, see [@silbigerNutrientPollutionDisrupts2018](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/readings/coral_reefs/Silbiger%20et%20al.%20-%202018%20-%20Nutrient%20pollution%20disrupts%20key%20ecosystem%20functions%20on%20coral%20reefs.pdf).

For a classic on corals and multiple stable states, see [@knowltonThresholdsMultipleStable1992](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/readings/coral_reefs/Knowlton-ThresholdsMultipleStable-1992.pdf).

In thinking about symbiont diversity, I've always enjoyed [@rowanLandscapeEcologyAlgal1997](https://files.celp-lab.org/biol311/readings/coral_reefs/Rowan%20et%20al%201997%20nature.pdf).
